title: AR NFT Explorer
tagline: Finding interesting NFTs is so boring -- let's spice things up and navigate the web of NFTs in AR!
description: In AR NFT Explorer you can find connected NFTs starting with a single address. You then traverse between users and contracts, picking NFTs that pique your interest. It is an experience that leads you down an NFT rabbit hole and builds a diverse web of NFTs. For any NFT, you can follow a link to a marketplace and place a bid or purchase!
how_its_made: This project uses Aframe and threejs for rendering, and the Moralis NFT api to query owner, contract, and token metadata from Polygon and the Ethereum Mainnet. WebXR is still very experimental, so device compatibility is extremely limited -- however, a 3D version can still be experienced in the browser.
